skills.name: grill-me-base
skills.description: Interview the user one question at a time to stress-test a plan, design, or decision tree until shared understanding is reached. Minimal domain-agnostic vendored variant; reads project adapters when available and does not auto-load documentation skills. Triggers: 'grill', 'grill me', 'stress-test plan', 'challenge this design', 'grill-me-base'.

skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.description: A grilling session that stress-tests a plan against the project's documented domain model — sharpens fuzzy terminology, challenges it against the existing glossary, cross-references it with the code, and updates documentation (CONTEXT.md, ADRs) inline as decisions crystallize. The domain-aware variant of grill-me — use this instead when the repo has (or should have) a CONTEXT.md glossary or docs/adr/ decision records. Triggers include "grill with docs", "stress-test this against our domain model", "does this match our language", "check this against our glossary", "grill this and update the docs", or any time a non-trivial plan needs to be reconciled with the project's documented decisions.

skills.name: olko-design-rules
skills.description: Read-only rule catalogue for design and code review across stacks. Design rules (DRY, YAGNI, KISS) apply at plan time and code time. Code rules (nesting, cryptic identifiers, visibility, magic values, nested try/catch, collection-population blocks, linear scans, repeated mapping) apply at code time. .NET-only rules cover explicit enum values, sealed leaf types, and static field order. Never edits code; callers report findings with the rule id. Use when a stack style skill, plan review, or code review applies design rules. Triggers: 'design rules', 'DRY YAGNI KISS', 'check duplication', 'speculative abstraction', 'overengineering', 'olko-design-rules'.

skills.name: olko-feature-planner
skills.description: Turn broad product outcomes into an Epic with business value and progress by Feature, then define user-facing Features and independently testable, one-PR Tasks. For implementation planning, return the complete accepted Feature/Task hierarchy to the orchestrator, which creates every Task plan in the same session.

skills.name: olko-implement-current-code
skills.description: Adopt already-written changes into one Task worktree, validate them against its approved Task plan and Feature context, and hand them to the standard implementation orchestrator. Does not own implementation verification or delivery. Triggers: 'olko-implement-current-code', 'adopt current changes', 'transfer my session changes to a worktree', 'resume implement-current-code'.

skills.name: olko-implement-new
skills.description: Implement one accepted Task from its Task-specific plan in the session's attached worktree; ensure observability, track progress, verify, commit, and merge. Triggers: 'olko-implement-new', 'implement the plan', 'implement Task', 'resume implement-new', 'continue implementation'.

skills.name: olko-implementation-closure
skills.description: Post-merge steps 11, 12, 13, 12a, and 12b of olko-implementation-orchestrator: post-merge acceptance E2E, main-stack runtime verification, worktree cleanup, Task plan removal, Feature completion audit, and Feature plan cleanup.

skills.name: olko-implementation-journal
skills.description: Implementation journal template and resume procedure for olko-implementation-orchestrator; load when creating the journal or resuming a Task.

skills.name: olko-implementation-pr-gates
skills.description: Steps 8b (Obsidian knowledge-base gate) and 8c (editor verification gate) of olko-implementation-orchestrator; both must pass before the merge.

skills.name: olko-investigate-existing
skills.description: Investigate an existing mechanism by name or description — find it, analyze its behavior, map its flow, verify AGENTS.md docs, check technology architecture and coding style compliance, assess optimization/extension opportunities and predict potential errors, then offer to create improvement plans via a declared plan skill. Use when the user wants to understand, document, or improve an existing mechanism in the codebase.

skills.name: olko-plan-backlog-discovery
skills.description: Epic/Feature/Task discovery path of olko-plan-documentation-orchestrator: draft, one content review, approval-gated publish to YouTrack, and read-back.

skills.name: olko-plan-change-triage
skills.description: Task change impact triage and step 8c tracker reconciliation for olko-plan-documentation-orchestrator; load when a material change to a Task's scope appears.

skills.name: olko-plan-editor
skills.description: Plan an accepted Feature in one session: create its business and technical plan plus one implementation plan file for every child Task; later implementation remains per Task. Also supports Epic plans and scoped Task-plan revisions.

skills.name: olko-plan-finalization
skills.description: Final steps 9–11 and the completion report of olko-plan-documentation-orchestrator: Domain changes recommendation, memory persist, opening the plan directory.

skills.name: olko-research-new-functionality
skills.description: Research a proposed functionality in the current repository, trace existing flows and boundaries, compare suitable architecture patterns, estimate measurable impact, and produce an implementation-ready integration report. Use when the user asks to analyze, evaluate, scope, or design a new cross-cutting feature before implementation.

skills.name: olko-ste100-skill-adapter
skills.description: Review and adapt the wording of OpenCode skills, agents, prompts, and AI commands using ASD-STE100 for English or a Polish clarity profile inspired by STE. Preserve behavior, routing, and executable content. Recommend which related skills and agents should use these principles.

skills.name: olko-summary
skills.description: End-of-session summary - track session-affected files, list investigated docs, summarize changes and problems, outline solved/pending issues, future steps, improvement suggestions, and helpful links. Triggers: \"summarize session\", \"session summary\", \"wrap up session\", \"olko-summary\".

skills.name: olko-task-scope-gates
skills.description: Task-to-PR scope gate with the code-path budget (step 7b), and the procedure for work found outside a Task's scope, for olko-implementation-orchestrator.

skills.name: olko-worktree-compose-isolation
skills.description: Canonical Compose isolation contract for worktree builds, restarts, and log/trace/DB checks; load in steps 6, 7, and 11 of olko-implementation-orchestrator.
